title: Invite opened on a signed-in phone
summary: What a bipe.chat/convite/<code> link does when the phone already has an account (bipe-chat/bipe#460): the chat with the inviter when there is one, else a sheet to talk to the inviter or to make a new account with this invite.

code.description: The invite code from the link (BipeInviteLink.code). Never shown and never logged.

phase.description: checking: GET /v1/invites/{code} and, with a handle, GET /v1/handles/{handle} run. invited: the sheet shows. notValid: valid false; the sheet shows bipe_invite_no_longer_valid. failed: no network; bipe_error_network and a retry.

inviterHandle.description: The inviter's handle without @, from the invite preview.

inviterName.description: The inviter's display name from GET /v1/handles/{handle}, else @handle.

appear.effect: Previews the code. With an inviter that resolves to an account that already has a DM with the account on screen: closes the sheet and opens that chat. An inviter that is the account on screen or another account on this phone: invited without the chat row.

chat.effect: Closes the sheet and opens profile-link-open for inviterHandle: the person, from where the first message follows the chat-request rules. Shown only with a handle.

newAccount.effect: Opens account-new's sign-up at signup-name with this code (SignupStart without inviteId: a cancel does not revoke someone else's invite). The sign-up keeps its inviter: signup-done opens the chat with the inviter, as a first sign-up does.

notes: Only the Conversas chat list takes the link, as with profile links (profile-link-open). A phone with no account keeps onboarding-welcome openInviteLink.
bipe_invite_signed_in_title takes inviterName. Without a handle the title is bipe_invite_signed_in_title_anonymous and there is no chat row.
Nova conta here follows account-new: the personal row's cap applies (bipe_account_cap_reached), and the invite step does not show.

The states around the first run (bipe-chat/bipe#460): a sign-in that fails after create shows bipe_signup_signin_failed with one retry (signup-create); a killed app resumes with POST /v1/signup/resume or the stored credential (account-start); offline steps keep their input and show bipe_error_network; an inviter whose account is gone gives no inviter chat (signup-done).
